|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/battleplananddrawtheirfire.html</ref>

Wow! This combo effect packs the full punch of [[Battle Plan]] while only removing the risky retrieval from [[Draw Their Fire]]. This is card efficiency at its finest. Starting it, you can limit your opponent's ability to play multiple interrupts early game due to low activation and late game due to lack of Force. Best of all, this [[Draw Their Fire]] can't come out and cost you the game. The only drawback is the fact that it cannot be pulled with [[Your Insight Serves You Well]].
